reason: axe could not read the background of the Jane Black name on the card preview, and both probes came back incomplete too. I sampled the card art under the 84x20 text box: the lightest pixel is rgb(43,43,62) under white text, a worst case of 13.8:1 against 4.5:1 required. On billpay.inbox-zero the flagged element is the dropzone's file input, set to opacity 0.00001 with pointer-events none and tabindex -1, so no one sees its text.

The probe reproduces the sweep's reading: Tab lands on the Agent Card checkbox input, which is opacity 0. The component draws its focus ring on the surrounding label instead, a 3px rgb(112,115,147) ring with a white 1px gap that appears only while the input has focus-visible, so keyboard users see where focus is.
criterionAnalysis: 2.4.7 Focus Visible needs a visible keyboard focus indicator, and one appears: the label gets box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #fff, 0 0 0 3px rgb(112,115,147) only while the input matches :focus-visible (none when unfocused), around the whole 333x48 Agent Card control, about 4.6:1 against white, so 1.4.11 is met too. 2.4.3 Focus Order holds: Tab reaches the checkbox after the Virtual and Physical radios, and the next stop is the info icon beside its label, in visual order. 4.1.2 holds: the tree exposes checkbox Agent Card. The transparent input is the usual custom-checkbox pattern, so no A or AA criterion fails.

reason: On both sampled states the Control type combobox has autocomplete="garbage", an invalid token set next to data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore, so autofill suppression is deliberate. The field chooses a spend-control mode, not information about the user, and the tree still exposes combobox Control type, so no A or AA criterion fails.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in its Input Purposes list (name, address, email, card number and so on). Control type picks the spend-control mode for a new card, which is card configuration, so no listed purpose matches and 1.3.5 does not apply. The tree still exposes combobox Control type with its expanded state and popup, so 4.1.2 holds. No other A or AA criterion covers the autocomplete token.
